Formula For valid H3 cells, c is the center unit vector and a[e], b[e] are consecutive boundary unit vectors. L[e] = R * atan2(length(cross(a[e], b[e])), dot(a[e], b[e])); P = sum(e) L[e]; A = 2*R^2 * sum(e) abs(atan2(dot(c,cross(a[e],b[e])), 1+dot(a[e],b[e])+dot(b[e],c)+dot(c,a[e]))). R is the WGS84 authalic radius in the selected meters/kilometers unit. Single-face hexagons evaluate equivalent gnomonic expressions using integer lattice offsets to avoid cancellation; pentagons and face-crossing cells use f32 unit vectors directly. Totals use all boundary edges even if edgeLengths storage is truncated. Invalid cells give zero.

For valid H3 cells, c is the center unit vector and a[e], b[e] are consecutive boundary unit vectors. L[e] = R * atan2(length(cross(a[e], b[e])), dot(a[e], b[e])); P = sum(e) L[e]; A = 2*R^2 * sum(e) abs(atan2(dot(c,cross(a[e],b[e])), 1+dot(a[e],b[e])+dot(b[e],c)+dot(c,a[e]))). R is the WGS84 authalic radius in the selected meters/kilometers unit. Single-face hexagons evaluate equivalent gnomonic expressions using integer lattice offsets to avoid cancellation; pentagons and face-crossing cells use f32 unit vectors directly. Totals use all boundary edges even if edgeLengths storage is truncated. Invalid cells give zero.
